scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c green,blue "npm run dev -w @pla/web" "npm run dev -w @pla/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pla/web && npm run build -w @pla/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pla/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pla/worker && npm run typecheck -w @pla/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
